title: Beyond PINNs: Boundary-Enriched Holomorphic Networks for Laplace Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.29922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) solve partial differential equations by penalizing their residual, but this formulation can be difficult to optimize for solutions with singular behaviour. We focus specifically on the two-dimensional Laplace equation, whose strong analytical structure allows the governing equation to be enforced directly in the neural representation. We compare a hybrid harmonic-neural model with a holomorphic neural network whose output is harmonic by construction and therefore requires only boundary training. We further enrich the holomorphic model with singular functions chosen according to the interior angle and boundary conditions at each junction of boundary segments. On six singular benchmarks, the enriched model is the most accurate of the neural models we compare. translated_title: 超越PINNs：面向拉普拉斯问题的边界增强全纯网络
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过惩罚偏微分方程的残差来求解方程，但这种形式对于具有奇异行为的解可能难以优化。我们专注于二维拉普拉斯方程，其强大的解析结构使得控制方程可以直接在神经表示中被强制满足。我们比较了一种混合调和-神经模型与一种全纯神经网络，后者的输出在构造上即为调和函数，因此仅需边界数据进行训练。我们进一步根据边界各分段交界处的内角和边界条件，选取相应的奇异函数来增强该全纯模型。在六个奇异基准问题上，增强后的模型在我们所比较的神经模型中精度最高。然而，在四个具有闭式解的基准问题上，该闭式解恰好落在增强项所张成的空间中，对这些项进行最小二乘拟合即可……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种输出天然满足调和性质的全纯神经网络，并结合依据边界交界处内角与边界条件选取的奇异函数进行增强，仅需边界训练即可高精度求解具有奇异性的二维拉普拉斯问题，精度超越传统PINNs。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes boundary-enriched holomorphic neural networks—harmonic by construction and augmented with singularity functions selected according to junction angles and boundary conditions—achieving higher accuracy than PINNs on singular Laplace problems through boundary-only training.
